verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's programmatic surface is its official MCP server at api.cfo.ai/mcp. Through it an agent can read and change most of the Model: Pages, Table and Canvas blocks, formulas, Variables, and Dimensions. It can also drive Ari chats via edit_chats/inspect_chats and has undoable writes, so much of the UI's core modeling work is reachable programmatically. However, there is no documented REST API, no API keys (clients sign in as a person), no OpenAPI spec (all probe paths 404), and no explicit UI-parity statement. Missing for 10: documented parity for UI actions such as connecting integrations, read-only report sharing, and Excel export; a general-purpose REST API with token auth and an OpenAPI spec; independent or hands-on corroboration.
